channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Palestinian father buries baby killed by Israeli gunfire in West Bank
item.description: A Palestinian father in Hebron has buried his seven-month-old son after the baby was killed by Israeli gunfire

item.title: 100 days into the war on Iran, Trump fails to rally US support
item.description: Unpopularity of the war may affect the US approach to the conflict and hurt Republicans in the elections, analysts say.

item.title: Israeli attacks in Lebanon kill 12 people, including high-ranking soldiers
item.description: The deaths include a brigadier general, a captain and a soldier killed while travelling on the Khardali-Nabatieh road.

item.title: Videos show Kuwait intercepting ballistic missiles from Iran
item.description: Kuwait says it intercepted seven ballistic missiles over residential areas, resulting in some debris but no casualties.

item.title: Groom killed hours before his wedding in Gaza
item.description: Muhannad Farwana never got to wear his wedding suit, Israel killed him in an air strike hours before his wedding.

item.title: US and Iran exchange strikes in Gulf in latest test of ceasefire
item.description: The US military strikes Iranian drones and radar sites and Tehran says it has targeted US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Funeral held for baby shot dead by Israeli troops in occupied West Bank
item.description: The seven-month-old boy's shrouded body was wrapped in a Palestinian flag and carried by his father to the graveyard.

item.title: Iran says staff blocked from entering US after players given World Cup visas
item.description: Iranian officials say technical staff have been denied visas, hours after the US said players could enter the country.

item.title: Lebanese general among three soldiers killed in Israeli attack on car
item.description: The Israeli military is investigating the incident in south Lebanon, where it is fighting Hezbollah.

item.title: Is there an AI stock market bubble, and is it ready to burst?
item.description: Despite the Iran war, inflation and debt fears, US markets keep hitting record highs, fueled largely by AI. BBC's Samira Hussain looks into whether that bubble will burst.
